keeper & provenance

every line has provenance. a session on infinite hill is written by us from public-domain texts — the actual scripture, the actual stories — and read by a keeper, a scholar of that tradition, before a voice records it.

a keeper can veto a session. they can change a word. they own the standard for their door and nobody at infinite hill can overrule them on their own tradition.

we never write a prayer. we never blend traditions in a session. we never compare which door is true. we teach yours, from your texts, checked by your people.

the keeper desks are being seated; names appear here only once signed.

start now. it's free.
